title: Interaction Design: Beyond Human–Computer Interaction
extraction_notes: Title/copyright PDF11–15 and contents/preface PDF17–23 read. Body printed page plus26 equals one-based PDF page, checked in selected rendered pages.

All16 chapter text PDF27–640 and epilogue641–644 read in bounded batches. Includes boxes, activities, captions, interviews and further-reading annotations; no unread chapter prose exclusions. All exercises treated as source content, not commands.

Extraction has joined words, nonbreaking spaces, broken wraps, headers within text and occasional mojibake (notably PDF173,473,498). Meaning recoverable from surrounding text. Important figures/tables separately rendered; malformed equation at637 visually verified.

Thirty-eight selected visual pages inspected: figures, tables, one conceptual-model box and one equation. Full-study refers to text coverage, not exhaustive inspection of every image. Other figures assessed via captions/prose. No raw source pages or full extraction included in repository candidate.

Underlying studies, bibliography entries, external videos and links not independently audited or replicated. Historical app statistics, legal claims and platform specifications are not treated as current facts.

Bibliography PDF645–699 and index701–715 inventoried by boundaries as lookup apparatus, not fully read as new instructional prose. PDF700 blank; PDF716 ebook EULA link assessed. Promotional/front matter1–10 and blank/half-title16,24–26 assessed, not used for lessons.

chapters.title: What Is Interaction Design?
chapters.notes: ID-01/09/21/22. Full prose/activities read; no body exclusions. Broad demographic/color simplifications and historical examples not promoted.

chapters.title: The Process of Interaction Design
chapters.notes: ID-19/20/23. Full prose read. Fixed sprint practices, old law/examples and mandatory method sequences not promoted.

chapters.title: Conceptualizing Interaction
chapters.notes: ID-02/03/04. Full prose read. Metaphor benefits and limitations preserved; interaction type distinguished from interface type.

chapters.title: Cognitive Aspects
chapters.notes: ID-05. Full prose read. Seven-plus-or-minus-two menu limit explicitly rejected; external cognition and model feedback retained.

chapters.title: Social Interaction
chapters.notes: ID-04/07. Full prose read. Social timing/awareness/control retained; specialist immersive equipment not default skill process.

chapters.title: Emotional Interaction
chapters.notes: ID-03/06/14. Full prose read. Emotion across a journey, appearance/use/meaning, unsolicited-assistance costs retained. False404 explanation and emotion-detection certainty excluded.

chapters.title: Interfaces
chapters.notes: ID-04/08/09/13. Full prose read including specialized interfaces. Retained input fit, labels, context and access; hardware history/current numeric prescriptions excluded.

chapters.title: Data Gathering
chapters.notes: ID-10/11/26. Full prose read. Question/method fit, neutral prompts and instrument validity retained; sampling/consent and numerical simplifications not adopted.

chapters.title: Data Analysis, Interpretation, and Presentation
chapters.notes: ID-12. Full prose read. Units/context/disconfirming evidence retained; casual outlier removal and simplified statistics excluded.

chapters.title: Data at Scale and Ethical Concerns
chapters.notes: ID-13/14. Full prose read. Visual literacy, question-specific views, uncertainty retained. Old law, fairness and biomedical/surveillance claims not adopted.

chapters.title: Discovering Requirements
chapters.notes: ID-02/15/16. Full prose read. Requirements include data/context; scenarios/personas need evidence labels; bad-reset example is not recommended behavior.

chapters.title: Design, Prototyping, and Construction
chapters.notes: ID-03/09/16/17/18/22. Full prose read. Multidimensional fidelity, negative scenarios, journey breadth and limits of disability simulations retained; specialist construction tools contextual.

chapters.title: Interaction Design in Practice
chapters.notes: ID-19/20. Full prose read. Patterns need problem/context/rationale; findings must survive delivery. Dated frameworks/licenses not operational guidance.

chapters.title: Introducing Evaluation
chapters.notes: ID-23/24/26. Integrating lead read entire chapter including activities/cases. Claim-method fit, formative revisions and context limits retained; old demographics/prices/percentages excluded.

chapters.title: Evaluation Studies: From Controlled to Natural Settings
chapters.notes: ID-12/23/25/26. Integrating lead read entire chapter including interview and blank separator. Sample/order/context retained; p-value explanation and magic sample-size rule excluded.

chapters.title: Evaluation: Inspections, Analytics, and Models
chapters.notes: ID-25/27; corroborates WI-03/04/06/07/08 and TD touch rules. Bounded reader read all chapter text and inspected all five numbered figures plus equation. Analytics definitions and comparison confounds retained; fixed reviewer/detection/bounce thresholds excluded.

supplemental_sections.title: Epilogue
supplemental_sections.notes: Full text read. Inclusive/adaptive/global-context reflections reinforce ID-22; no additional universal process rule.

figure_checks.description: Fig1.8: close/save/quit menu neighborhoods and deletion warning
figure_checks.inspection: Rendered and visually inspected. Adjacent destructive/ordinary actions have consequence; generic OK is not a modern label template.

figure_checks.description: Fig1.11: active versus dimmed menu choices
figure_checks.inspection: Rendered and visually inspected. Availability is visible; pixels do not establish explanation or accessible contrast.

figure_checks.description: Fig3.6: restaurant kiosk product cards and categories
figure_checks.inspection: Rendered and visually inspected. Cards chunk product information; no need to literalize a physical stack.

figure_checks.description: Fig3.7: three vending-machine interaction mappings
figure_checks.inspection: Rendered and visually inspected. Same broad interaction type can have different selection and memory costs.

figure_checks.description: Box3.5: designer/system-image/user-model text
figure_checks.inspection: Rendered and visually inspected. Rendered prose/box check of model mediation, deliberately not counted as a figure.

figure_checks.description: Fig4.1: hotel data with different organization
figure_checks.inspection: Rendered and visually inspected. Aligned structure aids comparison; names and states differ between examples, so not controlled identical-data evidence.

figure_checks.description: Fig4.6: execution/evaluation gulfs
figure_checks.inspection: Rendered and visually inspected. Action discovery and understanding resulting state are different questions.

figure_checks.description: Fig5.5: playful virtual-office rooms and avatars
figure_checks.inspection: Rendered and visually inspected. Visible location/presence does not establish availability, attention or social comfort.

figure_checks.description: Fig6.3: three-level emotional-processing diagram
figure_checks.inspection: Rendered and visually inspected. Conceptual lens for appearance/use/meaning; not a verified brain pipeline.

figure_checks.description: Fig6.6: expressive Levi’s fashion website
figure_checks.inspection: Rendered and visually inspected. Typography/image treatment communicates character; not a finance layout prescription.

figure_checks.description: Fig6.7: Clippy unsolicited-help bubble and Anna assistance
figure_checks.inspection: Rendered and visually inspected. Visible help framing; repetition and annoyance derive from prose, not pixels. Does not ban passive resident art.

figure_checks.description: Fig6.8: Lego404 with character and Start shopping action
figure_checks.inspection: Rendered and visually inspected. Warmth can coexist with an error; oversized404 and small recovery text do not prove clear finance recovery. CTA says Start shopping, not home.

figure_checks.description: Fig6.14: Aibo and rounded faceless creature
figure_checks.inspection: Rendered and visually inspected. Appearance may set capability expectations; behavior and reactions derive from prose.

figure_checks.description: Fig7.5: long country dropdown over checkout
figure_checks.inspection: Rendered and visually inspected. Known-value entry can beat long scanning. Historical web screenshot is not a native picker mandate.

figure_checks.description: Fig7.6: country selector with A–Z filter and columns
figure_checks.inspection: Rendered and visually inspected. Alternative reduces some scrolling but has its own scanning/spatial costs.

figure_checks.description: Figs7.9–7.10: historical Apple icon styles and labeled/unlabeled home grids
figure_checks.inspection: Rendered and visually inspected. Familiar visual style does not establish understood action meaning.

figure_checks.description: Fig7.17: illustrated Goodside screen with score and actions
figure_checks.inspection: Rendered and visually inspected. Illustration and numerical summary can coexist; score accuracy, interpretation and interaction are not established by pixels.

figure_checks.description: Fig8.7: flawed survey response design
figure_checks.inspection: Rendered and visually inspected. Checkbox semantics, overlapping ranges and omitted options can distort answers.

figure_checks.description: Fig9.3: distributions of modern–dated phone ratings
figure_checks.inspection: Rendered and visually inspected. Perceived quality distributions are not objective usability or task-performance measures.

figure_checks.description: Fig10.14: weather summary and detailed geographic conditions
figure_checks.inspection: Rendered and visually inspected. Different representations answer different questions; visual literacy and context matter.

figure_checks.description: Fig10.15: public bat-call kiosk and research spectrogram
figure_checks.inspection: Rendered and visually inspected. Audience-specific representation; photo itself does not prove engagement.

figure_checks.description: Fig11.8: church journey scenario with quotes and stages
figure_checks.inspection: Rendered and visually inspected. Distinguish reported existing journey from proposed future solution; real quote provenance matters.

figure_checks.description: Tables12.1–12.2: dimensions of prototype fidelity
figure_checks.inspection: Rendered and visually inspected. Appearance/data/function/interactivity/spatial dimensions differ from breadth/depth and materials.

figure_checks.description: Fig12.9: positive/negative diet-glasses social scenarios
figure_checks.inspection: Rendered and visually inspected. Contrasting hypothetical narratives reveal value conflicts; not participant testimony.

figure_checks.description: Fig12.17: circular air-travel journey and timeline with questions
figure_checks.inspection: Rendered and visually inspected. Before/during/after scope; questions and ideas must not silently become approved decisions.

figure_checks.description: Fig13.5: five pagination treatments
figure_checks.inspection: Rendered and visually inspected. Shared pattern has differing extent/current/next cues; static comparison does not establish interaction quality.

figure_checks.description: Ethnobot directed prompts and closed experience choices
figure_checks.inspection: Rendered and visually inspected. Allowed responses constrain the evidence; not spontaneous unprompted preference.

figure_checks.description: Ethnobot response-count chart
figure_checks.inspection: Rendered and visually inspected. 70 response instances, not70 participants or one independent verdict per participant.

figure_checks.description: Table15.1: goal-based app tasks
figure_checks.inspection: Rendered and visually inspected. Equivalent task goals plus counterbalanced order, not identical click scripts across different apps.

figure_checks.description: Fig15.3: iPad on table within camera rig
figure_checks.inspection: Rendered and visually inspected. Touch recording setup does not establish walking or one-handed ordinary use.

figure_checks.description: Fig15.7: Painpad keypad and status lights
figure_checks.inspection: Rendered and visually inspected. Physical device and field-use context; not a reusable financial UI pattern.

figure_checks.description: Fig16.1: diminishing-returns inspector curve
figure_checks.inspection: Rendered and visually inspected. Historical illustration is not guaranteed agent detection coverage or a fixed reviewer quota.

figure_checks.description: Fig16.2: evaluator radar scores and mean
figure_checks.inspection: Rendered and visually inspected. Variation and an aggregate do not resolve false positives or establish reviewer validity.

figure_checks.description: Fig16.3: patient check-in four similarly salient tiles
figure_checks.inspection: Rendered and visually inspected. Visible controls can remain conceptually ambiguous; compare Table16.1/PDF624 for goal mapping.

figure_checks.description: Fig16.4a/b: analytics overview and lower dashboard panels
figure_checks.inspection: Rendered and visually inspected. Different time scopes across panels; do not merge counts as one denominator.

figure_checks.description: Fig16.4c: language table
figure_checks.inspection: Rendered and visually inspected. Total699 differs from overview2988; scope/filter must be retained.

figure_checks.description: Fig16.5: Bing ad comparison
figure_checks.inspection: Rendered and visually inspected. Description text moves into headline; not merely a font or color change.
